_about: SINGLE-TRANSLATION SHELF: one-off translations gathered from the earlier stretch of the list: art and music (Leonardo's Treatise on Painting, Rigaud, 1802; Bosanquet's translation of Hegel's Introduction to the Philosophy of Fine Art, 1886; Dürer's Of the Just Shaping of Letters; Forkel's Bach (Terry, 1920); Rimsky-Korsakov's Principles of Orchestration; Rolland's Handel; Rosa Newmarch's Tchaikovsky; the recollections of Gounod and Massenet; Duprè; Rodin; Reber's History of Ancient Art; Lalanne on etching; bookbinding and leather; the violoncello; singing), letters and memoir (Thomas Platter's autobiography, the Countess Krasinska's journal, Juliette Drouet's letters to Hugo, Princess Louise of Belgium), King Alfred's Old English Soliloquies of Augustine, R. W. Church's Dante with F. J. Church's De Monarchia, the Dhammapada (Woodward), Gandhi's Guide to Health, Merezhkovsky's Flaubert, Rydberg's Magic of the Middle Ages, Heeren's Ancient History, Renan's English conferences, Pfungst's Clever Hans, Leduc, Taine's Pyrenees, Old Paris, guilds, acrobats, vagabonds (Luther's Liber Vagatorum), French cookery, Vesuvius in 1872, and a few First World War and Weimar documents. Each title gates on its own translator (_surname_by_slug). US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 47); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_surname_note: Per title: the translator's name forms.
